scripts.speaker: Inventor Jaax
scripts.text:
Hey, you're carrying
way too much stuff. Why don't you stash it away in Kafra Storage? We can talk after you do that, right?

scripts.speaker: Inventor Jaax
scripts.text:
My name is Jaax.
Without ego, I can
say that I am perhaps the
^663300greatest inventor of our time^000000.

scripts.speaker: Inventor Jaax
scripts.text:
This time, I've
created something
truly extraordinary. I call them... ^663300Magic Quivers^000000 !! This will be remembered in history as an
arrow revolution!

scripts.speaker: Inventor Jaax
scripts.text: I've studied magic and quivers for years, working night and day until I finally figured how to condense arrows with magic! With magic quivers, you'll be carrying more arrows, but with less weight!

scripts.speaker: Inventor Jaax
scripts.text: Would you like to try using one of my arrow quivers? I have no doubt that someone like you can appreciate my genius!
